description: This file defines classes, enums, and structures related to HARQ (Hybrid Automatic Repeat reQuest) processes management in a 5G NR scheduler, including HARQ process states, modes, handling, and per-UE HARQ entities within a cell.

classes.name: harq_timeout_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying HARQ process timeouts.

classes.name: harq_utils::harq_state_t
classes.description: Enumeration of possible HARQ process states.

classes.name: harq_utils::base_harq_process
classes.description: Common parameters for DL and UL HARQ processes.

classes.name: harq_utils::dl_harq_process_impl
classes.description: Parameters and state for a DL HARQ process.

classes.name: harq_utils::ul_harq_process_impl
classes.description: Parameters and state for a UL HARQ process.

classes.name: harq_utils::cell_harq_repository
classes.description: Repository managing HARQ processes for DL or UL in a cell.

classes.name: harq_utils::harq_pending_retx_list_impl
classes.description: List of HARQ processes with pending retransmissions.

classes.name: ocudu::cell_harq_manager
classes.description: Manages all HARQ processes in a cell, including creation, slot updates, and retrieval.

classes.name: ocudu::unique_ue_harq_entity
classes.description: Manages HARQ processes for a single UE, including reconfiguration and access.

classes.name: ocudu::dl_harq_alloc_context
classes.description: Context info for DL HARQ allocation during scheduling.

classes.name: ocudu::ul_harq_alloc_context
classes.description: Context info for UL HARQ allocation during scheduling.

classes.name: ocudu::dl_harq_process_handle
classes.description: Interface to access and update a DL HARQ process.

classes.name: ocudu::ul_harq_process_handle
classes.description: Interface to access and update a UL HARQ process.

methods.name: harq_timeout_notifier::~harq_timeout_notifier
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the HARQ timeout notifier interface.

methods.name: harq_utils::harq_state_t
methods.description: Enum class representing HARQ process states: empty, pending_retx, waiting_ack.

methods.name: harq_utils::harq_mode_t
methods.description: Enum class representing HARQ operation modes: normal, feedback_disabled_or_mode_b.

methods.name: harq_utils::base_harq_process::cancel_retxs
methods.description: Cancels retransmissions for the HARQ process.

methods.name: ocudu::cell_harq_manager::add_ue
methods.description: Creates and adds a new UE HARQ entity to the cell.

methods.name: ocudu::cell_harq_manager::contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE with given index exists.

methods.name: ocudu::cell_harq_manager::pending_dl_retxs
methods.description: Returns list of DL HARQ processes with pending retransmissions.

methods.name: ocudu::cell_harq_manager::pending_ul_retxs
methods.description: Returns list of UL HARQ processes with pending retransmissions.

methods.name: ocudu::unique_ue_harq_entity::reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures HARQ processes for the UE.

methods.name: ocudu::unique_ue_harq_entity::has_empty_dl_harqs
methods.description: Checks for free DL HARQ processes.

methods.name: ocudu::unique_ue_harq_entity::has_empty_ul_harqs
methods.description: Checks for free UL HARQ processes.

methods.name: ocudu::dl_harq_process_handle::dl_ack_info
methods.description: Updates DL HARQ process state based on ACK/NACK info.

methods.name: ocudu::ul_harq_process_handle::ul_crc_info
methods.description: Updates UL HARQ process state based on CRC feedback.
